principle: The director sees the whole song. The image model sees only a LOCKED crop of the already-approved image plus the CURRENT lyric's visual target and a tiny invariant style brief. Zero future-lyric information is supplied to image inference.
workflow: Review/edit the FULL 106-line map at directing time. This is private to the director/orchestrator, not image-model context.
For S001, establish the first small static art segment using ONLY S001 lyric, its visual target, and fixed material style.
For S002+, extract a bounded crop from the RIGHT EDGE of the current accepted mural; paste it unmodified into a wider canvas on the LEFT and mask only the blank RIGHT extension.

Send to inference ONLY that crop/canvas/mask, the CURRENT lyric and current visual target, plus invariant style/craft constraints. NO next lyric, NO prior lyrics, NO whole storyboard, NO anticipated future symbols, NO previous narrative summaries.
Accept result only if protected overlap is pixel-identical and new imagery depicts current lyric within expected visible framing. If not, reject/retry; never silently crossfade mismatched results.
Once accepted, append ONLY newly generated right-hand pixels to the accepted mural; hash immutable prior content and new segment. Stop/review periodically to limit accumulated visual drift.
Only after completion: test a simple lyric-timed left-right crop before constructing final photoreal 3D camera shot.

invariants.visual_style: Hand-laid cathedral-grade ceramic-and-glass tesserae, natural gold/stone grout, luminous cobalt/indigo with amber, ivory and garnet; front-facing flat mural texture only.
invariants.protected_region: Any pixels provided from an accepted mural are immutable. If a provider regenerates the whole input despite the mask, reinsert the exact protected input with compositing; verify visually that the new boundary doesn't create an unnatural hard join.
invariants.progressive_extension: Only paint into an explicit blank right-hand mask, do not move/replace previous scenes.
invariants.avoid: No text, detached topic collage, perspective cathedral interior, camera, animation or dynamism in artwork.
invariants.crop_size: Choose enough context to continue road, horizon, material, perspective and people at the seam. Start ~25–40% of the target frame width and measure results. Longer history is NOT necessarily helpful.
invariants.checkpoint: Track each accepted crop's SHA-256, generated region SHA-256, dimensions, prompt, model and manual verdict; preserve a reproducible accepted mural.
invariants.outpaint_limitations: Not all image models support true mask/locked pixels. If none is available, generate only candidate right-hand strips, composite against exact prior pixels, and reject seams that fail. Do not claim continuity just because instructions were given.

note: The director/orchestrator may use a future storyboard to plan composition, but it must NOT leak future lines, adjacent-line hints, or full script into the per-image inference payload. The whole-story visual map is still reviewed before generating any image.
